title: Python Programming
description: A four-week, project-based Python course for school leavers with little or no coding experience. Each week you build small, useful programs – a tip and VAT calculator, a shopping list, a grades analyser, a quiz game and an expense tracker – and finish with skills you can show to clients and employers.
outcomes: Write and run Python programs that use variables, numbers and text
Store and process data with lists and dictionaries
Make decisions and repeat work with if statements and loops
Organise code into functions and use standard library modules
Save and read data in text and CSV files
Build a small expense tracker you can add to your portfolio
